claim: CPM at HQMC P&R-RFF owns Marine Corps GTCCP execution per MCO 4600.40C

fix: Cite MCO 4600.40C Encl (2) Ch 2 para 8.a(8) and Appendix E. MARADMIN 115/19 is cancelled.

claim: Cases route through HL4 to HL3 to CPM for resolution

fix: List the reports by name. Report IV is Activity Text, VI and VIII are Declined Authorizations, V and IX are Delinquency-Hierarchy, VII and X are Aging Analysis.

quote: During the check-in process APCs are required to transfer the new individual's account into the gaining command's hierarchy.
fix: The gaining APC pulls the account in at check-in. The losing APC checks the Marine out, sets PCS or Mission Critical status and adjusts limits. After 30 days in the losing hierarchy the CPM chain forces the transfer.

claim: APC closes the IBA on separation and coordinates with the DMM per MCO 4650.39A Chapter 9

fix: The GTCC vendor runs the soft pull. The APC never sees the score. The APC confirms the applicant consented or completed the DD 2883.

quote: The restricted card has lower credit and retail limits than a standard card.
fix: The vendor issues the card type by score. Standard needs a FICO above 659. Restricted applies below 660 or when the applicant declines the check and the supervisor signs a DD 2883. Remove the merchant category line, it has no source.

claim: Credit-score check runs on every new IBA applicant
quote: the GTCC vendor performs a credit score check (soft pull) on each new card applicant who agrees to the credit score check.
fix: Say the check runs for applicants who agree. Decliners complete the DD 2883 and receive a Restricted card.

claim: Contractors do not hold IBA eligibility for a standard IBA
quote: DoD contractors are not authorized to possess or use any type of GTCC, regardless of the type of contract they are operating under.
fix: Drop the word standard. Contractors cannot hold any GTCC type. Remove the line saying contractors route per component policy.

claim: Volunteer position eligibility flows from component policy
quote: Individuals serving in voluntary positions are not eligible to obtain or use an IBA.
fix: State volunteers are not eligible for an IBA. Their transportation costs go on a CBA when the command has one and its IOP allows it.

claim: Recruiting personnel hold a specific application path and recruiting-side limits
quote: Military personnel assigned to recruiting duty are authorized to use their GTCC for official reimbursable expenses in their local recruiting areas
fix: Recruiters apply through the normal IBA path. 040404 only allows card use for reimbursable local recruiting-area expenses, which other cardholders cannot use for local travel.

claim: Foreign national personnel assignment triggers a 040402 review
quote: Foreign national personnel, with the exception of those serving in the U.S. Uniformed Services, are not authorized to possess or use an IBA.

fix: Move the training and DD 3120 SOU to before application submission. Add the three year refresher and SOU renewal.

fix: Annex 1 sets limits by account type and approver. Standard default is $7,500 credit and $250 cash and retail. Restricted default is $4,000 credit, $250 cash and $100 retail. APCs at HL4-7 approve to $15,000, HL3 to $25,000, CPM to $50,000. Increases last 12 months standard and 6 months restricted.

claim: Restricted card upgrades after the qualifying window with a new check
quote: Applicants must agree to a new credit score check (soft pull) by the GTCC vendor and must meet the minimum credit score to be upgraded
fix: Remove qualifying window. The cardholder applies for an upgrade, agrees to a new soft pull and must meet the minimum score.

fix: State charge-off at 211 days past billing. The IBA debt belongs to the cardholder, not the unit. A charged-off cardholder cannot get a new card before the SmartPay contract ends on 29 Nov 2031.

claim: Charge-off transfers the debt to collections
